long_biography.plain_text:
Sweeney's entry into industrial contracting came through his trade as a heavy-duty diesel fitter. In 2000, he established Sweeney's Mechanical Services to maintain and refurbish earthmoving machinery. Equipment hire followed, then a contract-mining division that broadened the company from workshop support into drilling, blasting, load-and-haul, crushing and screening.

The enterprise adopted the SMS Mining Services name and was later combined with Rivet Group's complementary transport and logistics businesses. Sweeney held executive responsibility through that phase. His present directorships at Andel Resources and SMS Holdings cover mining operations and strategy. Andel's platform finances, develops and processes gold resources through investment and operating partnerships.

More than twenty Australian LinkedIn results share the name Daniel or Dan Sweeney, including professionals associated with PentenAmio, Capex Power, Baker Ag Advantage, education, retail and unrelated engineering roles. Their profile slugs, employers and geographies do not match the saved SMS profile and none of their facts is transferred.

Mandatory Forbes-first searches covered site:forbes.com/profile, exact-name Forbes searches and SMS-, Perth- and Australia-qualified variants. No relevant dedicated profile appeared. A New Jersey Wells Fargo adviser named Daniel Sweeney is excluded.

Business sources use both Daniel Sweeney and Danny Sweeney. The saved exact LinkedIn, shared SMS employer and identical founder and managing-director history support the familiar-name equivalence, but no unverified middle name is added.

No reliable public source reviewed supplies a birth date, place of birth, middle name or secondary nationality. Those researchable fields remain blank rather than being inferred from low-tier people-search material.

Priority and person-relevant social searches covered LinkedIn, Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube and TikTok with exact-name, Danny, SMS Mining and Perth qualifiers. The saved LinkedIn is verified; no other personal account cleared the collision threshold. The unrelated crypto-focused Linktree and Scottish bagpiper website were excluded.

The official company website is proposed as Company Website because it is the current domain of Sweeney's defining platform. Corporate Facebook and Instagram links are not proposed as personal accounts.

Service is used for wealth creation and current primary industry because Sweeney's defining platform supplies equipment, maintenance and contract-mining services to resource owners. Metals & Mining is a plausible adjacent sector, especially through Andel, but public evidence does not show mineral ownership or production outweighing the services business in his personal holdings.

Broad Self-made is supported by the documented trade-to-founder path and absence of an inherited core enterprise. Sources do not disclose launch capital or the family's financial position, so neither independent-start nor advantaged-start subtype is assigned.

Founder is the current wealth relationship because official current material identifies Sweeney as founder of SMS Mining and director of SMS Holdings and Andel Resources. Day-to-day management of SMS includes other executives, but that does not displace the founder relationship.

Heavy equipment is the only active closed-world tag proposed. The inactive Mining services tag is not assigned, commodity-specific mining tags would overstate customer and project exposure, and no taxonomy candidate was created.
Short and long biographies contain 50 and 102 words respectively, use British English, are structurally independent and exclude vessel facts, age, changing company scale and contract values.
